terbaru.judul: ML-Based Hierarchical Prediction for Practical Energy Scheduling in Dynamic NTN-WPT Systems
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes an energy-scheduling approach that jointly optimizes energy efficiency, task completion rate, and task waiting time for power transfer from low Earth orbit satellites to terrestrial mobile user devices (UDs).

terbaru.judul: Emergent Problem-Graph Alignment in RL-Discovered Entanglement Topologies for QAOA
terbaru.pelajaran: In the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), the entanglement topology, where qubit pairs are connected by two-qubit gates, is conventionally set equal to the edge set of the problem graph.

terbaru.judul: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
terbaru.pelajaran: We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that leverages future-video prediction solely as a training-time supervision signal.

terbaru.judul: Momba: Network Modernization Improves Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we integrate recent advances in neural network design: (i) observation and feature normalization, (ii) weight normalization, and (iii) modeling of distributional returns with an entropy-regularized MORL algorithm.

terbaru.judul: Game-Theoretic Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Modeling Competitive Human Driving: A Cut-in Prediction Study
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a comprehensive analysis comparing data-driven IRL models against an established physics-based game-theoretic approach for predicting aggressive, safety-critical cut-in lane changes.
